description: This file defines the JmsSerializer class, which provides methods for serializing objects to XML and deserializing XML content back into objects, acting as a bridge to legacy XML serialization code within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JmsSerializer
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods to serialize objects into XML strings and deserialize XML strings into objects, facilitating communication via JMS.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts an XML content string into an Object by parsing the XML and using the XmlSerializer. Logs a warning if the XML document cannot be parsed.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts an Object into an XML string by creating a new XML document, serializing the object into the document, and returning the XML as a string.
